summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 'My Demos' floating popup feature. All backend APIs and frontend UI functionality working correctly. Popup appears at bottom-right on page load, expanded by default, with full minimize/expand functionality. Demo table displays all required columns (Time Slot, Action, Status, X). Both Call icon and [Dial] link successfully open the shared DialingModal component with correct contact information. Demo deletion works properly. Popup correctly floats above page content with z-index 999.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/seed-demos - Seeds demo data successfully
Backend: /api/demos GET - Retrieves all demos
Backend: /api/demos POST - Creates new demo
Backend: /api/demos/{id} PUT - Updates demo status
Backend: /api/demos/{id} DELETE - Deletes demo
Backend: /api/seed - Seeds lead data for integration
Backend: /api/leads GET - Retrieves leads for dialing integration
Frontend: My Demos popup appears at bottom-right corner on page load
Frontend: Popup is expanded/open by default
Frontend: Popup has correct z-index (999) and floats above page content
Frontend: Demo table shows all required columns (Time Slot, Action, Status, X)
Frontend: Demo entries display correct info (time, client name, company, mobile)
Frontend: Today/Tomorrow tabs switch demo content correctly
Frontend: Minimize button (-) collapses popup to button
Frontend: Clicking minimized button expands popup again
Frontend: Demo count badge visible on minimized button
Frontend: Call icon (green phone) opens dialing popup
Frontend: [Dial] link opens dialing popup
Frontend: Dialing popup shows correct contact info from demo
Frontend: Dialing popup uses shared DialingModal component
Frontend: X button removes demo from list
Frontend: Popup uses fixed positioning (doesn't affect page layout)
Integration: Demo data correctly passed to DialingModal
Integration: Contact info (mobile, name, company) matches between demo and dialing popup
